title: Wind Turbine
subtitle: A base and up to 5 blades
text:
Place a Wind Turbine Base, then stack Turbine Blades on top. The blades join into one helix and turn together, faster as they make more power.

Each blade gives up to 50 FE/t, so 5 blades give up to 250: 50 x blades x height x open air x weather, all measured at the top blade. Height counts from Y 64 (nothing) to Y 160 (full). Open air is the share of air in the 9x9x9 space around the top blade. Rain gives x1.25 and thunder x1.5.

A 6th blade or higher, or a blade with no base, does nothing. The base stores 50k FE and gives LV out of its bottom and sides. Right click it to read it.
